Verovio 6.3.0

The optional WebView2 engraving feature bundles the Verovio JavaScript and
WebAssembly distribution from the verovio@6.3.0 npm package. Verovio is
licensed under GNU LGPL version 3 or, at your option, any later version.
The corresponding license texts are in COPYING and COPYING.LESSER.

Package provenance:
  https://registry.npmjs.org/verovio/-/verovio-6.3.0.tgz
  SHA-1: a11cce5a4126a5ed1e11418f1a28614b36705c94
  Git revision: 425dd7b6ba26edcecbe345c10b15586d095743d9

The default CLI and native Win32 GUI do not include or load Verovio.
